annotations.exact_quote: Pairwise constraint propagation (PCP) aims to propagate a limited number of initial pairwise constraints (PCs, including must-link and cannot-link constraints) from the constrained data samples to the unconstrained ones to boost subsequent PC-based applications.
annotations.reason_zh: 论文核心任务为成对约束传播，明确将must-link与cannot-link从受限样本传播到未约束样本。

annotations.exact_quote: the augmented PCs by our method produce higher accuracy than state-of-the-art semi-supervised clustering methods when applied to constrained clustering
annotations.reason_zh: 从受限样本向未约束样本传播有限成对约束，并将增强约束用于约束聚类，符合有限监督与未标注样本结合的半监督设定。

annotations.exact_quote: we propose to use two separate carriers to represent the two types of links
annotations.reason_zh: 方法用两个独立载体表示并传播must-link/cannot-link两类样本间链接，即学习/修正样本间关系结构而非固定图。

annotations.exact_quote: the propagation is driven by the structure embedded in data samples and the regularization of the local, global, and complementary structures of the two carries
annotations.reason_zh: 摘要明确用局部、全局和互补结构对两类链接载体进行正则化，以结构一致性约束传播结果，符合图/流形正则化定义。
